svg.title: A full bag and a new item
svg.desc: Isaac and Garet in Vale, both bags full with 15 items each, are given a Nut. The game says "Isaac got a Nut.", "But you can't carry any more items." and "What will you drop?", and the item picker opens: the hand picks a member and one of their items, with its description and price shown. Here the Potion is dropped: it leaves Isaac's bag, the items after it each move up a place, and the Nut goes into the last place. An item that cannot be dropped, one the story needs or a cursed one being worn, is refused.
svg.text: GIVEN A NUT WITH EVERY BAG FULL
"What will you drop?" The hand picks a member, then an item.
ISAAC'S BAG BEFORE: 15 PLACES, ALL FULL
the rest move up a place
A story item, or a cursed one being worn, can't be dropped.
